messages:
Alex: quick q — I opened a terraform PR that projects a service account token into the uploader namespace so secret-projector can mint creds. link: https://git.redwood.ai/p/redwood/infra/pulls/482

Maria: send the plan output? worried about duplicate rolebindings in that ns — we already have an uploader-sa binding in prod/staging

Alex: pasted the relevant snippet from the plan:
```
# kubernetes_service_account.uploader will be created
+ resource "kubernetes_service_account" "uploader" {
+   metadata {
+     name = "uploader-sa"
+     namespace = "staging-uploader"
+     annotations = {
+       "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/uploader-role"
+       "kubernetes.io/service-account.token-projection" = "true"
+     }
+   }
+ }
```

Sam: hmm, token-projector + IRSA in same SA — ok, but if there is an existing RoleBinding that references `uploader-sa` with a different namespace or name this could create duplicates. Did TF try to import existing SA or is it creating a new one? :eyes:

Alex: TF is creating (no import). I thought we needed a fresh SA so the token projection doesn't leak to other pods.

Jen: quick suggestion — set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` on the general deployment pods and only allow projector sidecar to mount token. Otherwise tokens might get auto-mounted unexpectedly.

Paul: run `kubectl -n staging-uploader get rolebinding -o wide` and `kubectl -n staging-uploader get sa uploader-sa -o yaml` in staging to check. if rolebinding already grants the same role, TF create will cause a conflicting duplicate name error.

Alex: ran the commands in staging, output: 
```
$ kubectl -n staging-uploader get rolebinding
NAME                ROLE
existing-uploader   Role/uploader-role
$ kubectl -n staging-uploader get sa uploader-sa -o yaml\apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: uploader-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/uploader-role
```
So there is already an SA and RoleBinding. TF will fail if it tries to create the same SA name.

Sam: then plan should be updated to `terraform import kubernetes_service_account.uploader staging-uploader/uploader-sa` or change the resource to use `for_each` and adopt existing if present. Import is simplest for now.

Maria: also check the rolebinding subject selector — if it points to a serviceaccount in a different namespace TF creation may be allowed but semantically wrong. Confirmed above it's same ns.

Alex: ok I'll update the PR to import the existing SA and remove the rolebinding resource from the change (we only need the projected token annotation). I'll add a note to the PR description about automount changes. PR updated: https://git.redwood.ai/p/redwood/infra/pulls/482

infra-bot: deploy-checker: reminder — any change to SA/rolebindings needs a staged rollout and smoke test for auth failures. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Infra/sa-rolebinding-rollout

Jen: when you update the PR tag me, I'll review the import command and double-check that we don't accidentally remove the IRSA annotation.

Maria: LGTM once import + automount toggle are in and there's a short staging smoke test (list S3 buckets as uploader). Assign to eng-oncall for the rollout window. :thumbsup:
